{{Top|leg}}
'''General Quarters''' was located aboard ''[[Omze's Incredible Traveling Starport/Legends|Omze's Incredible Traveling Starport]]''. Run by the [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] [[Steward (occupation)/Legends|steward]] [[Brobius]], visitors to ''Omze's'' could rent passenger cabins for private use. The suites were pricey but well-appointed, and room service was available. The cabins had been renovated and refitted with luxury appointments and were soundproofed to insulate the clients from the noises of the ship.

However, [[Platt Okeefe/Legends|Platt Okeefe]] had heard rumors that [[Human/Legends|Humans]] renting the cabins were known to have mysteriously disappeared.
